title: The Controller relayed a machine's rescue code to the machine's operators
description:
A node started with a rescue volume shows the code of its rescue window on its console, and only there: the code gives whoever types it first an hour's os:admin certificate of the node's own CA, enough to make the node trust another fleet. The Controller streams the serial console of each machine it created to the machine's operators (`GET /api/machines/{id}/console`, operator role over the machines domain), hiding only PEM private keys - so an operator watching the console while an admin rescued the machine could read the code and use it first, becoming an admin of that node.

**Affected**: Controllers with machines on a hypervisor (libvirt, Proxmox VE) and operators who aren't admins of them; only while a rescue window is open.

**Fix**: the Controller hides every rescue or pairing code (five groups of four symbols, a whole word, escape sequences told apart) in the consoles it relays, for every reader - an admin included: whoever attached a rescue volume reads the code on the hypervisor's own console.

**Besides updating**: nothing.
